metadata.name: HN AI Report
metadata.description: Fetch top HN stories -> LLM filters for AI -> parallel fetch comments -> parallel LLM summarize -> final report.

settings.prompt:
Here is a list of top Hacker News stories (JSON format):
{data}

Your task: Select up to 5 stories that are most relevant to AI, LLMs, Machine Learning, or Deep Learning. If fewer than 5 are relevant, just return those.

Output ONLY a valid JSON array of objects containing 'id', 'title', and 'url'. Do not explain, no markdown formatting. Respond entirely in English.
